hook.name: AnyHook
hook.description: A fixed-fee (1%) swap hook for the klik.finance platform that charges 1% of the pair-side amount on every buy or sell, distributing 60% to a platform treasury and 40% to the token creator. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims during the swap to handle illiquid launch conditions, and an anti-snipe mechanism restricts purchases in the first few blocks after pool deployment.
